Statuses: Active (working) = truck is out on trips · Ready = repaired, waiting for Ops to take it · Idle = active but parked in the yard with no job · Under repair · Broken down on road · Accident. Available = active + ready in the yard (a ready truck counts as available even if Ops has not taken it). Down = under repair + broken down on the road + accident. Workshop time counts in working hours only (Mon–Fri 8:00–4:30, Sat 8:00–2:00, Sun off). Accident repairs are planned work: minor 3–5 days, major 7–10 days.

Who is holding the trucks that are down now bar = share of total hours lost · per truck = average since it went down

    1Find the truck
    ℹ How to use
    Type the truck number (e.g. 34551 or 74) and pick it from the list. Its status now shows below. Then fill the box for your work (Workshop, Ops, Gate…) and press Save. Every save shows on the dashboard at once for everybody and sends a phone alert.
    Made a mistake? Save again with the right status / trailer – the history keeps both lines, so everyone sees it was corrected. A case put on the wrong truck cannot be moved here – tell the Control Room.
    🔔 Phone alerts: open the app from the home-screen shortcut, enter your PIN and allow notifications. Alerts come even when the app is closed.

    Came in LOADED – why? Ops or Workshop, whoever knows first

    ℹ How to use
    Shows when a truck came in through the gate loaded. Choose who it is for (Workshop = fault / repair, Ops = parked with load), pick or write the reason, write who told you, then press Save reason.

    Report a breakdown Ops opens it – Ayo (Mack) / Coach (HOWO) see it at once · tyre faults → Segun

    ℹ How to use
    Use it when a truck breaks down on the road. Fill when, where, the fault and the driver. Add a short explanation and a photo if you can. Press Report breakdown – the road team sees it at once.
    Anyone hurt? Call the emergency number first, then report here. Not an accident? Report a breakdown instead
    2Workshop status
    ℹ How to use
    1. Choose the status (Under repair, Major, PM, Accident…).
    2. Write the job / fault, what it is waiting for, the crew and the job card number.
    3. Put the expected finish – it is required with a job card. The card then shows Today (before 4:30 PM), Overtime (after 4:30) or Next day. Ops plans with this time. If the time passes, give the reason and a new time.
    4. Tick Repeat if the same fault came back within 7 days.
    5. Press Save workshop status. When the work is finished choose Ready.

    On the road only for a road breakdown

    ℹ How to use
    Only for a road breakdown: who is handling it, where the truck is, who is on it and the expected finish (required). Choose Rescue if a tractor must go and take the trailer.

    Rescue on the road send a tractor to take this truck's trailer

    ℹ How to use
    Type the tractor that goes to take the trailer, add a note, tick the box if the driver moves to the rescue tractor, then press Send rescue.

    Trailer

    ℹ How to use
    Shows the trailer now on this truck. To change it, type the new trailer number and press Change trailer. Press Detach trailer if the truck is now without a trailer. Detached or changed by mistake? Type the right trailer number again and press Change trailer.

    🔄 Swap workshop only · swap back puts everything as before

    2Dispatch (Operations)
    ℹ How to use
    1. When the workshop gives you a ready truck, press Confirm truck received as ready.
    2. Choose the dispatch status (Booked, Driver assigned, No driver…), the driver and a note, then Save dispatch status.
    3. If the truck still has a problem, use Not taking this truck – it goes back to the workshop and a job card opens by itself.

    Not taking this truck? send it back to the workshop – a job card opens by itself

    Ready, waiting dispatch:
    2Gate
    ℹ How to use
    Choose Empty or Loaded, then press IN when the truck enters or OUT when it leaves. If you see already recorded, it was entered before – no need to enter it again.

    Ops outlook weekend and coming days – what to expect

    ℹ How to use
    For Ops: tell the workshop what to expect – the dates, how much work, and a note (e.g. need 10 trucks ready Monday 6 am). Press Save outlook.

    👤 DRIVERS add, edit, change status · extra drivers

    ℹ How to use
    • New driver: name, staff ID, phone, truck, then Save.
    • Change truck / driver: Press 🔁 Move on the driver, type the new truck – swap with the other driver, replace him or keep both. The old driver stays in the truck history with dates.
    • Driver left: Edit → Status → Left company → Save. He leaves the list (see Left company button), his truck becomes free, history is kept.
    • Sick / leave: Edit → Status → Save.
    • Phone numbers show to everyone who searches the truck – keep them correct.
    Copy from Excel and paste here. Columns in this order: Name, Staff ID, Phone, Join date, Truck. A header row is skipped.

    New driver

    Comments Workshop, Operations and management. Anyone with the link can read; your PIN is needed to write.

    ℹ How to use
    Write short comments about the work. If it is about one truck, put the truck number. Type your PIN and press Send – everyone with a PIN gets a phone alert.
    @ Mention: type @ and the first letters of a name (e.g. @ay), then tap the name – that person gets a special alert. @all sends a special alert to everyone – use it only for important messages.
    ↩ Reply: press Reply on a message, write your answer and Send – the reply shows the original message and its writer gets an alert. Tap the grey quote to jump to the original.

    History pick a period

    ℹ How to use
    Pick a period (yesterday, last 7 days, this month…) or choose the dates and press Show. Press Download Excel to keep the list.
    Friday meeting report (Ops + Workshop with MD) – last Friday 12:00 → this Friday 12:00, or any dates above
